description: Exact gated stabilityai/stable-audio-3-small-sfx snapshot at 05ca3857 with its T5Gemma text encoder (t5gemma-b-b-ul2, Gemma Terms of Use) from the same repository. The gated API masks LFS digests, so they and the plain-file bytes come from the ungated cocktailpeanut/stable-audio-3-small-sfx mirror whose blob IDs equal the official ones; its model_config.json differs only in repo_id, restored here and checked against the official blob ID. The Controller verifies every file at ingress with the provider token.
